question: Who is the author of the novel 'A Burning'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Megha Majumdar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The novel **'A Burning'** is written by **Megha Majumdar.**
 
• **Megha Majumdar **is an Indian novelist who lives in New York City. She was born in **Kolkata.**
 
• Megha Majumdar's debut novel, A Burning, was released in **2020** and became a New York Times bestseller.
